source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Direct XLSX Procedure explicitly specifies 500 Gen2-to-Gen5 changes, while the matched DeepSeek command explicitly calls the same Speed Change 34 case Gen3-to-Gen4. These are materially different coverage scopes and cannot be reconciled by inference.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The static review and conflict record are complete. Execution is pending an identified engineering input—the authoritative Speed Change 34 definition—so this remains REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION rather than an irreducible review blocker.

review_improvement: Detects and preserves the material scope mismatch, prevents unsafe execution, and defines how a corrected authoritative run can later remain traceable to this row.
independent_technical_reasoning: The two candidate generation pairs exercise different transmitter/receiver rates, channel equalization paths, and initial states; one cannot serve as evidence for the other. The Speed Change 34 label alone is not enough to decide which text is wrong, and adjacent numeric labels are not an allowed derivation source. Therefore the only safe engineering action is to freeze execution, obtain the vendor/owner mapping, and then enforce that mapping in every atomic cycle. This is an execution dependency rather than a failure to review: the discrepancy, risk, and required resolution are fully identifiable.
